markdown:
This guide to the best forex brokers in the UAE compares **IG, Pepperstone, eToro, Capital.com and Exness**. Start with the company issuing your actual account, its product permissions and your customer classification. A UAE office, group licence or promotional company does not establish that every trading product is locally authorised.

Check the [DFSA register](https://www.dfsa.ae/public-register/firms), [ADGM public registers](https://www.adgm.com/public-registers) and relevant federal records. The entities below are research leads, not completed account-allocation or legal checks.

## Quick comparison

| Broker | Research focus | Entity / record lead from the brief | What to establish |
|---|---|---|---|
| [IG UAE](https://www.ig.com/ae) | Research and proprietary tools | IG Limited / DFSA F001780 | Current activities, retail permissions and actual account |
| [Pepperstone UAE](https://pepperstone.com/en-ae/) | Platform choice | DIFC company / DFSA F004356; separate promotional company | Introducer versus actual trading-product issuer |
| [eToro](https://www.etoro.com/) | Social/multi-asset tools | eToro (ME) Ltd / FSRA 220073 | Product scope, restrictions and customer eligibility |
| [Capital.com UAE](https://capital.com/en-ae) | Proprietary CFD interface | Capital Com MENA Securities Trading LLC reported | Current federal permission and account issuer |
| [Exness](https://www.exness.com/) | Account and platform choice | Reported UAE presence needs direct verification | Current company/licence and actual product issuer |

**Link disclosure:** Account/site buttons are unpaid official destinations. Affiliate tracking is not active. They do not establish a locally issued account, customer eligibility or an endorsement to deposit.

## How we selected these brokers

The supplied brief identifies these five brands and local-presence leads. We keep a company's regulatory presence separate from the account actually offered. No live accounts, execution or withdrawals were tested.

Before applying, match:

- The legal company and the product issuer.
- Relevant licence, activities, restrictions and retail endorsement.
- Your residence, classification and intended product.
- Complete fees, liability, assets and complaint terms.

## Forex trading regulations in the UAE

Dubai's DFSA and ADGM's FSRA regulate their respective financial free zones. Federal capital-market permissions must be checked separately. One authority's record does not automatically cover another group company or every financial service.

### How to verify a broker

| Framework | Where to start | What to match |
|---|---|---|
| DIFC / DFSA | DFSA public register | Exact company, permitted activities and retail conditions |
| ADGM / FSRA | ADGM public registers | Financial services permission and restrictions |
| Federal permissions | Current official federal records and actual legal agreement | Company, activity category and product issuer |

Do not treat promotion/introduction permission as permission to issue every OTC product. A broker's UK or Australian company may also have different terms.

## 1. IG

**Research focus:** Proprietary tools, education and the intended DIFC account. The supplied lead is [IG Limited’s DFSA record](https://www.dfsa.ae/public-register/firms/ig-limited), reference F001780.

### Why consider IG

- Research and educational resources.
- Proprietary platforms and additional tools where offered.

### Trading costs

Check the actual spread, financing, conversion and non-trading schedule. Different products may use different charges.

### Trade-off

A broad global product range does not mean every product is available through IG Limited to every UAE retail applicant. Verify current permissions and the agreement.

### Open an IG account

[Open an IG account](https://www.ig.com/ae)

## 2. Pepperstone

**Research focus:** Platform choice and the distinction between local presence and the trading-product issuer. The [DIFC company record](https://www.dfsa.ae/public-register/firms/pepperstone-financial-services-difc-limited) is a separate check from other group entities.

### Why consider Pepperstone

- MetaTrader, cTrader and TradingView options.
- Standard/raw-style pricing models.

### Trading costs

Add both commission sides and financing to the spread. A 0.0-pip floor is not an average or full cost.

### Trade-off

The [UAE legal disclosures](https://pepperstone.com/en-ae/about-us/policies/legal) distinguish company roles. Confirm whether the proposed contract is issued by a local or overseas company; do not infer that from promotional permissions.

### Open a Pepperstone account

[Open a Pepperstone account](https://pepperstone.com/en-ae/intermediate-licence-selection)

Use the official licence-selection flow. Our [Pepperstone review](/reviews/pepperstone) is background, not a UAE allocation.

## 3. eToro

**Research focus:** Social/multi-asset tools and the specific [eToro (ME) Ltd FSRA record](https://www.adgm.com/public-registers/fsra/firms/financial-firms/etoro-me-ltd-220073), permission 220073.

### Why consider eToro

- Proprietary web/mobile interface.
- Social features and different investment categories.

### Trading costs

Confirm product-specific spreads, commissions, financing, conversion and service fees. Copying another trader does not eliminate fees or losses.

### Trade-off

Securities, custody, investing and leveraged currency products are different services. Match the actual instrument and customer class to the current permission; a multi-asset account does not establish every product's availability.

### Open an eToro account

[Open an eToro account](https://www.etoro.com/accounts/sign-up)

## 4. Capital.com

**Research focus:** Proprietary trading tools and the proposed MENA account. The brief identifies Capital Com MENA Securities Trading LLC.

### Why consider Capital.com

- Web/mobile interface and research tools.
- Education and integration choices to confirm.

### Trading costs

No separate commission does not mean cost-free trading. Check spreads, overnight financing, conversion and other charges.

### Trade-off

Match the company's [regulatory disclosures](https://help.capital.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016569340-Who-is-your-regulator) to current official federal records and your actual product. A general group claim is insufficient.

### Open a Capital.com account

[Open a Capital.com account](https://capital.com/en-ae)

### Trading costs

Minimums, spread, commission, financing and swap-free conditions vary by company/account. Do not import another jurisdiction's terms.

### Trade-off

Check the [Exness regulatory disclosures](https://www.exness.com/regulation/) and actual agreement. Local group presence does not prove that a particular account is issued by the UAE company.

### Open an Exness account

[Open an Exness account](https://my.exness.com/accounts/sign-up?lng=en)

## Additional brokers: Saxo and IC Markets

### Saxo

A [historical Saxo Dubai company record](https://www.dfsa.ae/public-register/firms/saxo-bank-dubai-limited) is not evidence of current permissions for every Saxo offering. Establish the current company and account before making a UAE-regulated claim. No Saxo application button is included.

### IC Markets

An international availability listing does not establish a locally issued UAE account. Our [IC Markets review](/reviews/ic-markets) offers general background; current local company/product permission has not been established here.

## What “best forex brokers in the UAE” should mean

Match permissions and account issuer before comparing platforms or price. Use our [forex calculator](/tools/forex-calculator) and [profit calculator](/tools/forex-profit-calculator) for stated cost scenarios; they do not predict returns or establish eligibility.

## UAE retail-trading protections explained

| Check | Why it matters | What not to assume |
|---|---|---|
| Retail classification | Determines applicable conduct requirements | Every account is retail |
| Client assets | Establishes custody/handling arrangements | Every failure produces full recovery |
| Margin/deficit | Determines liquidation and liability | Every account has identical loss limits |
| Complaints | Identifies the responsible company and jurisdiction | A local promoter handles every overseas dispute |

Read the actual terms. No universal compensation payout or negative-balance guarantee is established here.

## Are forex trading profits tax-free in the UAE?

Do not assume every trading profit is automatically exempt. Personal investment and business activities can have different treatment. Check current [Federal Tax Authority guidance](https://tax.gov.ae/) and obtain qualified advice for your facts. This guide makes no individual tax determination or blanket tax-free promise.

## Islamic forex accounts in the UAE

Swap-free arrangements vary. Confirm customer eligibility, qualifying instruments, administration charges, holding periods and any expiry of the terms. A marketing label is not independent Sharia certification or proof that the arrangement meets your religious requirements.

## Investor protection: what it covers

Conduct rules, client-asset arrangements, deficit terms and firm-failure procedures address different risks. Check the actual company, product and claim category. Ordinary market losses are not insured simply because a brand has a local regulatory presence.

## Payment methods in the UAE

Verify the legal beneficiary, fees, minimums, processing times and withdrawal route. A UAE-facing website does not establish every payment method or account currency.

### Can UAE traders deposit in AED?

Check direct AED acceptance versus conversion to another currency. Ask about both deposit and withdrawal conversion, ownership requirements and return-to-source rules. No specific AED method is confirmed here.

The [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) and [platform guide](/insights/best-platforms-for-day-trading) help assess assumptions and usability before committing funds.

## Red flags to avoid

- Promotion permission presented as product-dealing permission.
- A different company in the agreement from the advertised local entity.
- Guaranteed profits, blanket tax-free promises or personal payment beneficiaries.
- Swap-free claims without actual fees and eligibility terms.

## FAQs

### Is forex trading legal in the UAE?

Appropriate company, product and customer permissions matter. Check the relevant DFSA, FSRA or federal framework and the actual issuer. A local group office or promotional licence does not authorise every account or service.

### Which forex broker is best for beginners in the UAE?

No tested overall winner is established here. IG, eToro and Capital.com are learning/interface research candidates, subject to the actual products and permissions. Prioritise demo usability, costs and suitable liability terms.

### Are Islamic forex trading accounts available in the UAE?

Some providers advertise swap-free arrangements for eligible customers. Confirm the actual account, instruments, replacement fees and holding restrictions. Do not assume identical terms or independent Sharia certification.

## Final recommendation

Use the five-brand comparison to identify questions, then match the local/overseas company, product permission and customer classification. Compare full costs and contractual safeguards before applying or funding. Do not expose essential savings to leveraged losses.
